meta.name: calendar
meta.description: Calendar management and scheduling. Create events, manage meetings, and sync across calendar providers.

copy.tagline: 管理日程、创建事件、同步会议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要管理日历和安排会议
copy.tagline_en: Manage schedules, create events, sync meetings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to manage calendars and schedule meetings

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你管理日历：创建事件、安排会议、设置提醒、查看空闲时间、处理重复事件，并同步多个日历。
howto.when: 当你要求查看、创建或管理日历事件时触发，例如说“安排会议”或“显示本周日程”。

say.text: 帮我安排明天下午2点的会议
say.note: Claude 会创建事件并设置提醒

say.text: 显示我这周的日程安排
say.note: Claude 会读取并展示日历事件

say.text: 找一下明天下午1小时的空闲时间
say.note: Claude 会检查日历并推荐可用时段

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage your calendar: create events, schedule meetings, set reminders, check availability, handle recurring events, and sync across multiple calendar providers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to view, create, or manage calendar events, e.g., "Schedule a meeting" or "Show my calendar for this week."

say_en.note: Claude will create the event and set a reminder

say_en.text: Show my calendar for this week
say_en.note: Claude will read and display your events

say_en.text: Find a free 1-hour slot tomorrow afternoon
say_en.note: Claude will check your calendar and suggest available times
